content.text:
Choose Astra as the base. Graft Sol’s string-only change key, live reduced-motion cancellation, and identity/cancellation tests. Scores evaluate the designs, not verified implementations.

| Criterion | Astra | Sol | Luna |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Ownership and alignment | 2 | 1 | 0 |
| Coherent pending/result identity | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Minimal typed API | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| Accessibility, focus and scroll | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Testable delivery, preserved semantics | 2 | 2 | 1 |
| Total | 9 | 9 | 4 |

`ViewLinks align="start" | "end"` is justified. The existing nav owns `display:flex` and `flex-wrap:wrap` in `ui/styles.css`. A feature wrapper can right-position the nav’s box, but its wrapped lines still align left. Fixing that inside the feature would require styling shared internals or another presentation API. Let ViewLinks own line alignment; let the rankings page own the full-width placement below its intro. Defaulting to `start` preserves other callers.

Prefer persistent WAAPI over keyed CSS. A keyed subtree remounts descendants and resets their local state. The existing `RankingList` also animates inserted rows, so keying its parent unnecessarily restarts every row and bar animation. Persistent content preserves retained nodes and makes cancellation explicit.

Use a required `changeKey: string` and `children: Snippet`. Pass the loaded period, never the pending destination or raw URL. Skip initial mount, cancel previous animations on updates and destruction, and cancel immediately when reduced motion becomes active. No completion callback should change content. Prefer Astra’s opacity-only motion with a nonzero starting opacity to avoid visual blanking.

Keep selectors outside animated regions. Animate totals and all period-dependent summary content together; keep funder aliases outside. For rankings, animate the board while preserving controls. Native links and `data-sveltekit-reset={false}` remain intact.

Sol’s tests are the strongest graft. Add actual 320px wrapped-line alignment checks, unchanged content while navigation is pending, and focus assertions after committed navigation. The link’s scroll-reset attribute alone does not prove focus retention across SvelteKit navigation. Verify existing ranking entry animations alongside the new wrapper so their combined effect is intentional.
